summary: Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ), a SPAC, filed an 8-K regarding its proposed business combination with IQM Quantum Computers Oy. The transaction was announced on February 22, 2026; an extraordinary general meeting is scheduled for June 2026. The filing notes the appointment of Dr. Craig Ciesla as CTO and Dr. Inés de Vega as Chief Scientist. The registration statement was declared effective June 5, 2026, and the proxy/prospectus mailed. No pricing terms or advisor names are disclosed. Watch for shareholder vote outcome and potential redemptions, a key risk-arb spread driver. The filing is a classic SPAC de-SPAC update.
